### Validate when 'Prevent WP Dashboard Access' is not enabled

Tags: free, core_feature

Source: `UR_tests/04__setting_general_options/01__DashboardAccess.robot`

Steps as written:

```
Login To Wordpress
Generate random data
Wait Until Page Contains Element    ${user_registration_hover}
Mouse Over    ${user_registration_hover}
Click Element    link:Settings
Wait Until Page Contains Element    //span[contains(text(),'Security')]
Click Element    //span[contains(text(),'Security')]
Wait Until Page Contains    Prevent WP Dashboard Access    20s
Unselect All From List    id:user_registration_general_setting_disabled_user_roles
Execute Javascript    window.scrollTo(0,1000)
Wait Until Element Is Visible    (//input[@name='save'])
Click Element    (//input[@name='save'])
Element Text Should Be    //div[@id='message']//p    Your settings have been saved.
Add New Form    Dashboard Access
Click Button    ${update_form_btn}
Wait Until Page Contains    Success! Form successfully saved.
Click Element    ${preview_form_btn}
Switch Window    new
EmailDelivery_keywords.Register A New User    ${rand_first_name}    password    User successfully registered.
SeleniumLibrary.Open Browser    ${login_url}    ${browser}    options=add_argument("--incognito")
Maximize Browser Window
Set Selenium Implicit Wait    10s
Input Text    xpath://input[@name='username']    ${rand_first_name}
Input Text    xpath://input[@name='password']    password
Click Button    //button[normalize-space()='Login']
```

### Validate when 'Enable Hide/Show Password' is enabled

Tags: free

Source: `UR_tests/04__setting_general_options/02__enable_hide_show_password.robot`

Steps as written:

```
Login To Wordpress
Goto User Registration Settings'
Goto General Options
Enable Hide/Show Password
SeleniumLibrary.Close Browser
Open My Account page in incognito mode
Enter >> Username    ${wp_username}
Enter >> Password    password
Verify that show password is displaying
```
